# PromptStarters

A few things a person could ask the AI, as a wrapping row of prompt `Suggestion` chips. - **starters** are `{ id, label, text }`: the short `label` on the chip and the longer `text` it stands for. - **onSelect(starter)** runs when a chip is pressed, with the whole starter and nothing else. A starter suggests; it never sends on its own, so the caller decides what happens — usually putting `text` in a `PromptInput` for a person to read and send. - **label** names the group for assistive technology.

**Import:** `import { PromptStarters } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/labels/PromptStarters/PromptStarters.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/labels/PromptStarters/PromptStarters.stories.jsx` — Default, SelectHandsBackTheStarter, EmptyRendersNothing, FillsThePromptInput, Interactive

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/labels/PromptStarters/PromptStarters.mdx`

## Usage

Use `PromptStarters` to offer a few things a person could ask an AI feature,
before they've typed anything: an empty chat, a fresh reflection, a blank
prompt field. Once a conversation is underway, use `Suggestion` directly for
a single follow-up prompt instead of a full row of starters.

## Best practices

### Keep the label short, and put the prompt in `text`. {#keep-the-label-short-and-put-the-prompt-in-text}

A chip sits in a row, so its `label` is a few words that read as a request;
the full prompt it stands for goes in `text`.

Do: A short label for a longer prompt.
Don't: The whole prompt as the label.

### Offer a few. {#offer-a-few}

Three to five starters fit a row and can be read at a glance.

Do: A few starters to choose from.
Don't: So many starters the row becomes a wall.

### Write each label as a request. {#write-each-label-as-a-request}

The label says what the person is asking for, starting with a verb.

Do: Labels that read as requests.
Don't: Topic names that don't say what will be asked.

### Let `onSelect` decide what happens. {#let-onselect-decide-what-happens}

The component never sends on its own. The common pattern is putting the
starter's `text` into a `PromptInput` so a person can read and edit it before
sending, not sending it immediately on their behalf.

### Pass an empty list rather than a guard. {#pass-an-empty-list-rather-than-a-guard}

Don't guard the component with your own conditional: passing an empty
`starters` array already renders nothing, with no empty group left behind.

## Accessibility

- **A named group.** The row is `role="group"` with `label` as its accessible
  name, required so assistive technology announces the set together.
- **Each chip is `Suggestion`'s own control.** Keyboard reach, focus and the
  accept action all follow `Suggestion`'s accessibility contract.

## Related

- For a single follow-up prompt once a conversation is underway, use `Suggestion` directly.
- For where a selected starter's text typically lands, see `PromptInput`.

Same group: `AiLabel` · `AiMessage` · `CountTag` · `DateTag` · `SmartTag` · `StatusTag` · `Suggestion` · `Tag` · `TagGroup`

## Parts

1. **Group.** A wrapping row with `role="group"`, named by the required `label`.
2. **Starter.** A prompt `Suggestion` per entry in `starters`: the sparkle wand, the short `label` on the chip, and the longer `text` it stands for.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | A row of prompt chips. The group itself has no ground and no state. |
| Hovered, pressed, focused | Each chip reacts as a `Suggestion` does. |
| Empty | An empty `starters` array renders nothing. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Gap | `--stack-md` between chips and between rows, the same gap as a tag row. |
| Starter | A `Suggestion`, so its edge, words, grounds and focus ring are Suggestion's tokens. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Write a label of a few words that reads as a request: "Summarize this session". | Put a whole paragraph on the chip. |
| Name the group for what it offers: "Suggested prompts". | Leave the group unnamed. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `starters` | arrayOf (required) | `[]` | What to offer: `id` for the key, `label` on the chip, `text` for the prompt it stands for. |
| `onSelect` | func | — | Called with the starter that was pressed. It never sends anything itself. |
| `label` | string (required) | — | The group's accessible name, such as "Suggested prompts". |
| `className` | string | `''` | — |
